tools.name: swap_quote
tools.description: Best-price same-chain token swap quote via the KyberSwap aggregator (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc). Includes a disclosed 0.1% integrator fee.

tools.name: swap_build_tx
tools.description: Build an unsigned, non-custodial swap transaction (plus ERC-20 approval tx if needed) for the caller's wallet to sign. Same fee as swap_quote.

tools.name: crosschain_rate
tools.description: Cross-chain / cross-asset rate (BTC, XMR, LTC, SOL, ETH, USDC on many networks) via SideShift.ai. Same rate as sideshift.ai.

tools.name: crosschain_create_shift
tools.description: Create a variable-rate SideShift order; returns a deposit address. Funds settle directly to settleAddress (non-custodial for us).

tools.name: shift_status
tools.description: Status of a SideShift order created here.
